transcript.text: bosch washer FD 9409 not draining. ive cleaned the filter already. what part do i need?

You may not need a part at all. A kinked hose or blocked waste connection usually just needs straightening or clearing, so whether a part is needed, and which one, depends on what you find there. From what you have described, the most likely cause is blocked / kinked drain hose or waste connection. Next: Check the drain hose for kinks/crushing and the waste connection/standpipe for blockage (especially if the machine was recently moved). Let me know what you find.
Hose behind looks OK, no kinks. Sink drains normally too. Still need to know what part it is, I think the pump hums but nothing moves.

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump]
Based on what you've described, the part most likely needed is a replacement drain pump, but the exact one depends on your machine's full model number, which I couldn't match in our catalogue. On Bosch labels, "FD 9409" is usually the production code rather than the model number, so the E-Nr shown on the same label is what a supplier will need to identify the correct pump. The checks point to the drain pump. I could not find a confirmed match for model FD9409 in our parts catalogue, so check with the manufacturer or a parts supplier using the full model number, or ask an appliance engineer to fit it.
